texts.en:
We have discovered some £astral_threads£ Astral Threads. These are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding. Typically, these can only be harvested from Astral Scars or recovered inside £astral_rift£ Astral Rifts.

To perform various Astral Actions;

£dot_green£ Click the Discoveries button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the Astral Threads tab

                        £discoveries£

You can unlock additional actions by exploring Astral Rifts, which can emerge from Astral Scars or form through other anomalous events.
